summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or code. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text with clickable_ranges click spans (placed before width); Opacity merges blended color into the existing style so meta is kept; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (appended, existing tests untouched) and tests/test_tabs.py. No layout resolver change was needed because the Edge protocol already defines size, min_size (default 1) and fraction (default 1). Decisions to review: with duplicate names the bar position uses the displayed index rather than the full-list index from find_tab_by_name, to satisfy the underline-under-displayed-tab criterion; letter search applies only to single-character keys. Known limitations: Escape calls set_focus without await, so it has no effect and Python emits a never-awaited warning; a zero-width label is treated as a flexible edge by the resolver. Nothing was committed. Tests still need to be run.
